reference.text: So Macro Arsenal made you a companion. And one fine morning… its eyes lit up!

lines.text: Ever since, it watches over you, day and night. It knows your account by heart.
lines.tts: Ever since, it watches over you, day and night. It knows your account by heart.
lines.heard: Ever since, it watches over you, day and night. It knows your account by heart.

lines.text: A major release coming up? It warns you in time.
lines.tts: A major release coming up? It warns you in time.
lines.heard: A major release coming up? It warns you in time.

lines.text: A screen doesn't make sense? One click, and it explains it.
lines.tts: A screen doesn't make sense? One click, and it explains it.
lines.heard: A screen doesn't make sense? One click and it explains it.

lines.text: It prepares your orders… but you decide. Always.
lines.tts: It prepares your orders… but you decide. Always.
lines.heard: It prepares your orders, but you decide. Always.

lines.text: It doesn't promise miracles. It helps you keep a cool head.
lines.tts: It doesn't promise miracles. It helps you keep a cool head.
lines.heard: It doesn't promise miracles. It helps you keep a cool head.

lines.text: On days of doubt, it's there. On days of victory too.

lines.heard: On days of doubt, it's there. On days of victory, too.
